name: Custom Backpack
description:
FEATURES

  • Best material: Made from high-quality polyester
  • Fabric: 100% Polyester Canvas
  • GSM: Approximately 300g/m2
  • High-Quality Material: this backpack is built to withstand daily wear and tear, ensuring longevity and protection for your belongings.
  • Spacious Compartments: The backpack features multiple compartments, including a main compartment for larger items like books and ipad, and smaller pockets for essentials like keys, phones, and pens. The organized layout helps keep your items neatly stored and easily accessible.
  • Customizable Design: Personalize your backpack with custom prints. Whether it’s your name, initials, a favorite quote, or a unique design, make your backpack truly one-of-a-kind.
  • Comfortable Wear: Padded shoulder straps and a cushioned back panel provide maximum comfort, even during extended wear. The adjustable straps ensure a perfect fit for all body types.
  • Secure Closure: The backpack is equipped with sturdy zippers and secure closures to keep your items safe and prevent accidental spills.
  • Versatile Use: Ideal for students. This backpack adapts to various needs, making it a versatile accessory for any occasion.
  • Customization: Your design will be printed on one side of the backpack

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 5-7  working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7 – 15 working days average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Backpack

 

NOTE:

  • Actual color may differ slightly from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.5-2 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 

Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
